details.about: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform that millions of companies, from the largest enterprises to ambitious startups, use to accept payments and grow revenue. This infrastructure role works on the service platform's asynchronous execution (workflow engine) capabilities, building tools, SDKs and services for Stripe's own engineers. Multiple positions are available.
duties: Expand the service platform's asynchronous execution capabilities and make asynchronous systems easy to build, resilient and scalable
Improve the productivity and developer experience of the engineers who use these systems
Work with the team to solve problems for fellow Stripe engineers by understanding their needs
Use qualitative and quantitative metrics to set priorities and measure effectiveness
Deliver practical, reliable tools, processes and code refactorings
Design and build client SDKs for developers across Stripe
Improve, deploy, scale and manage services and databases
Contribute to open source frameworks such as Temporal
needs: Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field, plus 2 years of related software development experience
2 years each of software design; software testing and debugging; object-oriented design; and Python, C++, Go, Ruby or Java
6 months each of distributed systems (including Temporal or Cadence) and infrastructure design for large-scale distributed systems
details.benefits: Base salary $156,800 – $235,200 a year; any sales commissions or bonuses would be on top. Additional benefits may include equity, a company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses, a 401(k) plan, medical, dental and vision benefits and wellness stipends.
